name: oppenheimer-artillery-turret-forked
title: Oppenheimer Lance fork
author: DrAli, Minecrafter8001
description:
⚡ BECOME THE DESTROYER OF WORLDS ⚡

No ammo. No shells. No mercy. Just your power grid and a vaporized hive where a nest used to be.

Designate a target up to 10,000 tiles away. The lance charges for about 15 seconds, burns a beam across the map for about 11 more, and ends in a nuclear detonation up to 2,000 tiles in radius.

✦ REAL-WORLD YIELDS
The fire-control dial reads every shot in tons of TNT and names the real weapon it matches: MOAB, Little Boy, Fat Man, B83, B53, Castle Bravo. One lance at full power is a 221 kiloton shot, about ten Fat Man bombs. Ten lances at full power put 102.6 megatons into one crater, about seven Castle Bravos.

✦ BEAM OVERSCALING
Past full capacity the crater stops growing and the overkill goes into the beam instead: hotter, thicker, whiter, with wilder lightning and a wider scorch lane. Link up to 10 lances on one target and they converge into a single, angrier sphere.

✦ POWER DEFINES YOUR SHOT
The charge window is fixed. What your grid decides is how much energy the banks hold when it ends: yield trades power for joules, never for time. A grid that can't keep up still fires, just weaker.

✦ THERMONUCLEAR ACCURACY
The beam builds a sphere of ionized plasma, it collapses and releases, and a real shock wave follows the Sedov-Taylor blast law across the landscape. Damage comes from published lethality thresholds for blast overpressure and thermal burns. With Space Age, the ground is painted molten by the heat it saw, and the crater cools and glows for minutes.

✦ THE COST OF POWER
8 capacitor banks to operate. 32 for the full dial.

Welcome to the endgame.
